profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
My experience in software development encompasses a wide variety of environments, applications, languages, and hardware (military, commercial, shrink-wrap, internet, Assembly, Fortran, COBOL, C, SQL, Java, microprocessors to mainframes).
Most recently I participated in the development of the underlying engine (AMOS) that drives a host of Internet e-commerce sites such as SHOP.COM and ShopCompanion.com. AMOS provides a multi-vendor, multi-lingual, multi-currency, single cart shopping solution. I helped design and develop major UI features, system components, and DB schemas capable of supporting millions of shoppers, thousands of merchant accounts, and millions of products.  Responsible for the international capabilities of AMOS, including real-time currency conversion, localized formatting, and language support. Among the unique SHOP.COM features for which I had design and development responsibility are Price Alerts and eGifts (elements of which were awarded a U.S. Patent). On-going responsibility for all development related to the ShopCompanion.com website.

Specialties: Web UI Design for E-commerce sites, especially Gift related features, e.g. E-cards, Gift Registry, E-Gifts.  Java, SQL, CSS, HTML, Javascript, Adobe GoLive.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer / Project Leader
positions.description: Responsible for a team of 8 engineers porting "DeltaGraph Professional", an advanced charting and presentation-graphics application, from the Macintosh environment to Windows.  Localized versions in French, German, and Japanese.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer / Team Leader
positions.description: Responsible for the specification of international features and localizability of all OS/2 PM applications developed at SPC. Designed and developed a graphical-interface resource editor for use by translators.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Implemented major feature enhancements and internationalization to "Ability Plus", an integrated business software package for PC compatible hardware.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed hardware diagnostic, file management, and business applications software for a custom, point-of-sale terminal/back-office system.

positions.title: Systems Software Engineer
positions.description: Contract work for the U.S. Navy Fleet Numerical Oceanography Center. Performed hardware/software requirements analysis for several contract proposals. Implemented error detection/ retransmission enhancements for the NEDN communications network. Designed the Synchronous NEDN ADCAAP communications protocol. Participated in the operating system conversion of the NEDS-1 (Nova-based environmental data display station).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of a consulting team based at the U.S. Navy Fleet Numerical Weather Center. Performed hardware/software requirements analysis for several contract proposals. Developed the user interface controller and display data manager for the NEDS-1A (an 8080-based environmental data display station). Designed, developed, tested, and documented the Flight Planner and Communications modules of the Optimum Path Aircraft Routing System (OPARS). Miscellaneous scientific and satellite data formatting software. Operating system software for the NEDS-1 (Nova-based environmental data display station) including diagnostic software, Graphics CRT and plotter device drivers, and communications software.

projects.title: Chromanyms
projects.description: Chromanyms™ is an extension of the Symonyms™ Project, which seeks to explore underlying energies within the dimensions of Thought that coalesce and emerge as verbal, musical, or sculptural expressions of our human experience. Chromanyms.com is a viewer of these patterns, presenting them as arrays of unique word-colors based on a mapping of the visible-light color spectrum across a concordance of the selected literary source (e.g. King James Bible). The results are vibrant, full color, “wordless” mosaics corresponding uniquely to user-selected passages from each selected work.
